_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). PENDING RATCHET: the SYSTEM_PROMPT count-shape + capability-scope edit (prompt_version d894e119) stales every committed fixture, so these floors are NOT re-evaluated by CI until the human re-captures (the advisory branch returns first while all-stale). Floors are intentionally left at the f3a5ad27 baseline in-PR; the human ratchets them ~5pp under the post-recapture measured rates (eval/README.md 'Floor ratchet + bank growth') and grows the bank in the same sitting (deferred follow-up). Prior measured baseline (report.json @ prompt_version f3a5ad27, 60 cases): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (36/36), T4_answer_correct 0.78 (28/36), out_of_scope_honest 0.75 (18/24). Floors sit ~5pp under with extra headroom for temperature=0 re-capture jitter (1 in-scope case = 2.8pp). Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
